title: The merge queue's buttons and Push… show they're working

steps.waitFor: h1:has-text("Keep the sidebar's scroll on refresh")
body:has(h1:has-text("Keep the sidebar's scroll on refresh")) .review-panel button:has-text("Merge Next"):not([disabled])

steps.caption: Merge Next: Moving…, then it lands on its own: one click

steps.highlight: body:has(h1:has-text("Keep the sidebar's scroll on refresh")) .review-panel button:has-text("Merge Next")

steps.click: body:has(h1:has-text("Keep the sidebar's scroll on refresh")) .review-panel button:has-text("Merge Next")

steps.caption: Remove from Queue: Removing… until the train is rebuilt without it

steps.waitFor: body:has(h1:has-text("Remember the last open tab")) .review-panel button:has-text("Remove from Queue"):not([disabled])

steps.click: body:has(h1:has-text("Remember the last open tab")) .review-panel button:has-text("Remove from Queue")

steps.caption: Land All, in the backlog: its icon spins until the queue has started landing

steps.waitFor: body:has(h1:has-text("Remember the last open ticket")) .review-panel:has-text("Merged into main")

steps.caption: Push…: Pushing… from the confirmation until git push is done

steps.waitFor: body:has(h1:has-text("Remember the last open ticket")) .review-panel button:has-text("Push")

steps.click: body:has(h1:has-text("Remember the last open ticket")) .review-panel button:has-text("Push")

steps.waitFor: body:has(h1:has-text("Remember the last open ticket")) .review-panel:has-text("Merged into main"):not(:has(.action-busy))
